:rotating_light: **Do not post vulnerability details in this issue.**

:rotating_light: This issue tracker is **public**. Anything you write here
is visible to the world and indexed forever — including by anyone who would
exploit the bug before a fix ships.

## Report vulnerabilities privately

Follow the private reporting process described in
**[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/JordanNewell/claudeway/blob/main/SECURITY.md)**:

1. Email **<security@jordannewell.com>** with a description, reproducer,
   and affected versions.
2. If you have a PGP key, encrypt the report. (The project's PGP fingerprint
   will be published in SECURITY.md once generated.)
3. Do **not** open a public GitHub issue, blog post, or tweet until a fix
   has shipped and coordinated disclosure is complete.

See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/JordanNewell/claudeway/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for the full scope, SLA, threat model link, and disclosure policy.

## After you've emailed

You can open a placeholder issue here — **without vulnerability details** —
saying "I sent a security report via email on YYYY-MM-DD, awaiting ack." That
lets us track the timeline publicly without exposing anything.

This template exists only to redirect you. Anything posted here with actual
vulnerability details will be deleted on sight.
